svg.text: MPx Squeeze v1 · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. Element: seamless sintered 316L tube Ø20 × 2.0 wall, one end closed (integral or welded 2 mm disc), 85.5 long overall.
2. Join to base: fusion weld (TIG/laser, no filler or 316L filler) full circumference at the collar; weld must not close pores beyond 1 mm.
3. Every element: bubble point per ISO 4003 in IPA, record value; and clean-water flux at 0.3 bar (reject below 80 % of nominal).
4. Ultrasonic clean + passivate after welding; dry; bag in PE-free paper.
M14×1.5-6g, 7.5 long; S3 on shoulder Ø22
MEDIA SPECIFICATION (first pass, from Mott published KL)
Sintered media grade is not a liquid pore size: Mott rates grades 0.2–20 at
1.4–35 µm absolute in liquid. Grade 0.2 does not remove all bacteria;
the UV cap (v2) on the M14×1 stem covers disinfection.
